FROM THE NEAR QUAY, ACROSS: camera at eye level on the near quay edge, the open canal crossing the whole picture left to right in front of it, the far bank a band of crowded buildings along the top, the water running out of frame both sides.
LOW AT THE WATERLINE: camera set low a hand above the water on the near side, flat jade water filling the lower two thirds and crossing the frame, the far bank stacked along the top edge.
FROM A MOORED HULL: camera at gunwale height in a boat tied on the near side, the market spread across the picture left to right beyond it, one near hull cropping the bottom corner.
OFF THE WET STEPS: camera at the foot of a flight of water steps on the near bank, the canal opening out across the frame, the far bank a band above it, one step cropping the near edge.
BETWEEN TWO NEAR HULLS: camera at eye level with a hull closing each lower corner, the canal wide open across the middle of the picture between them, the far bank along the top.
FROM THE BALCONY, ACROSS: camera up one storey on a near balcony, looking down across the canal that crosses the picture left to right, the market boats laid out on it and the far bank along the top.
FROM THE UPPER WINDOW: camera at an open upper window on the near side, the canal crossing below and filling the near half, the far rooflines stepping along the top of the frame.
OVER THE LOADED DECK: camera just above a loaded deck on the near side, its cargo cropping the bottom edge, the open canal and the market crossing the picture beyond it.
PAST THE MOORING POST: camera at eye level with one leaning mooring post closing the near left, the canal running across and out of frame on both sides beyond it.
FROM THE SIDE-CANAL MOUTH: camera at the corner where a narrow side channel meets the main water, the main canal crossing the picture left to right and wide open, the far bank above.
ACROSS THE WIDE BASIN: camera on the near edge of a basin where the canal widens, the water filling the lower two thirds and reaching both frame edges, the town banked along the top.
FROM THE WASHING PLATFORM: camera low on a plank platform out over the water, the canal crossing the frame all the way across, the far bank stacked along the upper edge.
BEHIND THE CANOPY POLE: camera low with one bamboo canopy pole and its cloth edge closing the near left, the market crossing the picture wide beyond it.
THREE-QUARTERS ALONG THE FAR BANK: camera on the near side with the far bank set three-quarters away so its band of buildings recedes slightly to one side, the canal still crossing the whole picture.
FROM THE LOW SLIPWAY: camera at water level on a stone slipway on the near bank, the flat water crossing the frame and running out both sides, the market on it at mid-distance.
UNDER THE NEAR AWNING: camera at eye level with the edge of a cloth awning cropping the top near corner, the canal and the market open across the rest of the picture.
FROM THE TILTED DECK: camera on a slightly heeled deck on the near side so the horizon of rooflines sits at a small angle, the canal crossing the frame below it.
PAST THE STACKED CRATES: camera at eye level with a stack of plain crates closing the near right, the open canal crossing the picture past them, the far bank a band above.
FROM THE TURNING POOL: camera on the near edge where the canal turns and widens, the near water wide and flat across the whole frame, the town band along the top.
PAST THE LEANING LADDER: camera at eye level with an old timber ladder leaning at the near left edge, the canal crossing the picture past it and out of frame right.
OVER THE NEAR BASKETS: camera low over baskets set on the near stones, the canal crossing the frame beyond them and the market laid out across it.
FROM THE FERRY THWART: camera at seated height on a small ferry out on the water, the market crossing the picture on both sides of it, the far bank along the top.
HIGH IN THE TALL DOORWAY: camera in a tall waterside doorway one storey up on the near side, looking out and down across the canal that crosses the frame below.
ALONG THE NEAR MOORINGS: camera at eye level with two near hulls at the lower right set at an angle, the canal opening wide across the rest of the picture.
FROM THE STONE PARAPET: camera resting height at a low stone parapet on the near bank, the canal crossing the whole width of the picture, the town stacked in a band above it.

OVER THE NEAR ROPE: camera at eye level with a thick mooring rope crossing the foreground horizontally from left edge, the canal wide and open beyond it across the full picture, the far bank a band of buildings along the top.
FROM THE STONE ARCH: camera set just inside a low stone arch on the near bank, the arch framing the upper near edge, the canal crossing the full width of the picture below and the far bank beyond.
AT THE CARGO GANGPLANK: camera low at the foot of a plank running from near bank to a hull, the plank angling into the lower middle, the canal and market opening wide beyond it across the frame.
FROM THE FLOATING RAFT: camera at deck level on a flat bamboo raft out on the open water, the canal crossing the picture on all sides around it, the far buildings set back along the top edge.
PAST THE SPLIT BAMBOO: camera at eye level with a bundle of split bamboo leaning at the near right edge, the canal crossing wide beyond it and the far bank faint along the top.
BESIDE THE BELL TOWER: camera on the near bank at the base of a squat bell tower, its lower stones filling the near left corner, the canal crossing the picture level to the right of it.

DOWN THE LONG REACH: camera on the near bank looking along a straight stretch of canal that runs diagonally across the picture from near left to far right, the far bank receding along the upper right.
FROM THE COVERED JETTY: camera at the threshold of a roofed jetty on the near side, the jetty roof cropping the upper edge, the canal wide and light across the picture below it.

LOW ON THE PONTOON: camera flat on a floating pontoon, the pontoon planks filling the near bottom strip, the canal crossing the rest of the frame and the market boats spread across the middle distance.
BENEATH THE BRIDGE ARCH: camera positioned under a low bridge on the near side, the arch curving across the top of the picture and the canal running out through it into open market water beyond.
AT THE OAR LOCK: camera at gunwale height beside a wooden oar lock on the near hull, the oar handle rising at the near edge, the canal and far bank spread across the picture past it.
FROM THE PAGODA STEPS: camera low on broad stone steps at the base of a near pagoda, two steps cropping the lower edge, the canal opening across the frame and the market on it at middle distance.
PAST THE CLAY POTS: camera at knee height with a row of clay pots on the near stones closing the bottom strip, the canal crossing beyond them and the far town rising above.
OVER THE STERN LANTERN: camera just above a paper lantern mounted at the stern of a near hull, the lantern and its pole filling the near lower centre, the canal and market wide open beyond it.
FROM THE UPPER LANDING: camera on a wide timber landing halfway up a near staircase, the landing rail cropping the near lower edge, the canal crossing the frame below and the far rooflines above.
ALONG THE FAR CURVE: camera on the near bank where the canal bends so the far bank curves gently across the upper picture rather than running straight, the water filling the middle and lower frame.
PAST THE ANCHOR CHAIN: camera at water level with a heavy anchor chain dropping from the near left into the water, the canal opening wide and flat across the frame past it.
FROM THE REED BED: camera low in a narrow stand of reeds on the near edge, the reed stems rising at both sides of the frame, the canal and market open in the gap between them.
AT THE WATER GATE: camera just inside a timber water gate on the near bank, the gate timbers framing the near left and right edges, the canal and far bank visible through the open centre.
FROM THE DOCK CRANE BASE: camera at ground level beside the iron base of a small dock crane on the near quay, the crane leg filling the near corner, the canal crossing the picture beside it.
OFF THE HEMP FENDER: camera at hull height with a fat hemp fender pressed between two near hulls filling the lower centre, the canal and market spread wide across the upper portion of the frame.
PAST THE FOLDED SAIL: camera at deck level with a bundled and folded sail lashed to the near mast base, the sail cloth filling the near right, the open canal and far bank crossing beyond.
FROM THE INLET CORNER: camera set back in a small rectangular inlet on the near side, the inlet walls framing the near left and right, the main canal crossing the picture across the open end.
OVER THE NEAR SKIFF BOW: camera just above the pointed bow of a small skiff on the near side, the bow cutting into the lower centre, the canal and market crossing the frame wide beyond it.

AT THE TIDAL MARK: camera at the level of a high-water stain on the near stone wall, the stain running as a faint band across the near left, the canal and far market spreading across the rest of the picture.

THROUGH THE SPLIT BAMBOO FENCE: camera at eye level with a split bamboo fence running across the near edge, its gaps opening onto the canal beyond, the market crossing the picture left to right and the far bank a band above.
AT THE CORNER BOLLARD: camera low with a thick stone bollard filling the near right corner, the canal opening wide across the frame past it, the far bank of stacked buildings along the upper edge.

FROM THE PONTOON EDGE: camera at knee height on a floating pontoon on the near side, the pontoon planks cropping the lower edge, the canal crossing the whole picture beyond and the market laid out across it.
BESIDE THE CLAY JARS: camera at ground level with a row of large clay storage jars along the near left, the canal wide and flat beyond them crossing the frame, the far rooflines along the top.
DOWN THE ROPE LINE: camera at eye level with a taut mooring rope stretching from near left into the picture, the canal opening across the rest of the frame and the far bank above.
FROM THE REED BED EDGE: camera low at the edge of a stand of reeds on the near bank, the reeds cropping the near corners, the open canal crossing the whole frame beyond them.
UNDER THE STONE ARCH: camera centred inside a low stone bridge arch on the near bank, the arch framing the canal beyond which crosses the picture left to right, the far bank visible above the water.
ACROSS FROM THE RAMP END: camera at the foot of a wide loading ramp sloping to the waterline, the ramp surface filling the lower near edge, the canal and market spreading across the frame beyond.
FROM THE HALF-OPEN SHUTTER: camera just inside a ground-floor room at a half-open wooden shutter, the shutter board closing the left edge, the canal crossing the frame through the open half.
PAST THE HANGING NETS: camera at eye level with draped fishing nets hanging from a pole at the near left, their mesh closing that corner, the canal wide and open across the rest of the picture.
AT THE OVERFLOW CHANNEL: camera low at the lip where a small overflow channel meets the canal, the lip cropping the near lower centre, the flat water spreading across the frame and the town above.

FROM THE INNER COURTYARD GATE: camera at the gate of a waterside courtyard on the near bank, the gate posts framing the near edges, the canal crossing the picture beyond and the market on its surface.
OVER THE NEAR FLOWER TRAYS: camera low above a row of shallow wooden trays laid on the near stones, the trays filling the bottom edge, the canal and its market boats crossing the frame beyond.
BESIDE THE TILTED PLANK BRIDGE: camera at eye level with a narrow plank bridge angling away from the near left, the bridge edge receding into the frame and the canal wide open below and beyond it.

FROM THE SECOND LANDING: camera at the height of an intermediate landing partway up a bank staircase, the stone tread cropping the lower near edge, the canal crossing the whole picture below and the far bank above.

BETWEEN THE HANGING LANTERNS: camera at eye level with two unlit paper lanterns suspended from a near crossbeam and cropping each upper corner, the canal and market open across the whole centre below them.

AT THE LOW STONE TROUGH: camera just above a long stone water trough along the near edge, the trough rim cropping the bottom of the frame, the canal crossing beyond it and the far bank in a band above.

FROM THE MOORED RAFT CENTRE: camera at deck height on the centre of a flat raft moored on the near side, the raft edge visible at the lower corners, the canal and market filling the rest of the frame.
PAST THE NEAR BARREL ROW: camera at barrel-top height with a row of wooden barrels filling the lower near edge, the open canal crossing the picture beyond them and the market spread across it.

FROM THE HIGH BANK CORNER: camera at standing height on a raised corner of the near bank where two stone walls meet, both walls receding into the lower corners, the canal crossing the full width beyond.

BESIDE THE CHARRED PILING: camera at eye level with a single dark charred timber piling rising at the near right, the canal running across and out of frame on both sides past it and the far bank above.
ACROSS FROM THE COVERED JETTY: camera under a narrow covered jetty roof on the near side, the roof soffit cropping the top of the frame, the canal crossing below in full light and the market on it.

OVER THE NEAR COILED ROPE: camera low over a thick coiled rope on the near stones, the coil filling the lower centre foreground, the canal crossing the frame beyond it and the town in a band at the top.

FROM THE MIDSTREAM STAKE: camera at water level lashed to a single stake driven into the canal bed, water flat all around and crossing the full frame, the near and far banks as equal bands at top and bottom.
BEHIND THE UPRIGHT OAR: camera at eye level with a long oar standing upright at the near centre, its shaft dividing the near frame, the canal and market crossing the picture on both sides of it.

BENEATH THE ARCHED BRIDGE: camera at water level just under a low stone arch on the near side, the arch framing the canal as it opens wide beyond and the market crossing the picture through it, the far bank above.

AT THE ROPE BOLLARD: camera at knee height with a thick rope looping from a near bollard down toward the water, the canal crossing the full width of the picture beyond it, the far bank a band along the top.
ATOP THE CANAL GATE: camera at the height of a timber lock gate on the near side, the water stepping down on the far side and the market crossing the picture beyond the drop.
FROM THE THATCHED SHELTER: camera set back inside a low thatched river shelter on the near bank, its dark fringe cropping the top of the frame, the canal and market open across the picture below.
JUST PAST THE PROW: camera level with the pointed prow of a near boat, the prow angling across the lower left corner and the canal spreading wide and flat across the rest of the picture.
OFF THE BAMBOO RAFT: camera at deck level on a flat bamboo raft moored on the near side, the raft planks cropping the bottom edge and the market canal crossing the frame beyond it.
OVER THE NEAR FISHPOTS: camera low above a row of woven fishpots stacked on the near stones, the canal crossing the frame beyond them and the far bank stepping along the top.
FROM THE CROOK OF THE CANAL: camera placed where the canal bends gently, so the water arcs slightly across the frame from lower left toward upper right and the far bank curves with it.
AT THE WATERSIDE COLUMN: camera at eye level with a single weathered column standing at the near edge, the canal wide and open across the picture past it, the market boats laid out on the water.
FROM INSIDE THE MOORED SAMPAN: camera at floor level inside a low open sampan on the near side, its low sides framing the bottom corners and the market canal crossing the picture in full beyond.
OVER THE TIPPED BASIN: camera low behind a large clay water basin tilted at the near edge, the canal crossing the whole picture beyond it and the far rooflines forming a band at the top.
FROM THE HIGHER TERRACE: camera two storeys up on a near terrace, looking steeply down so the canal fills the lower half of the picture end to end and the market boats appear foreshortened on it.
AT THE CLEFT IN THE WALL: camera at eye level in a narrow gap broken through a near wall, the wall closing both lower corners and the canal and market opening wide through the cleft.
BELOW THE HANGING LANTERNS: camera with a row of unlit lanterns strung low on the near side crossing the upper edge of the frame, the canal and market spread fully across the picture below them.
ACROSS THE REED BED: camera on the near bank behind a shallow stand of reeds, their tops crossing the near lower edge and the canal opening out wide beyond them with the market on it.

FROM THE TILTED PLANK BRIDGE: camera at mid-span on a slender plank bridge angled gently over the near water, the near water below the frame and the main canal wide open beyond the far end of the bridge.
AT THE WATERLINE RING: camera very low with an old iron mooring ring filling the near centre foreground, the flat canal spreading across the whole picture behind it and the market at mid-distance.
FROM BESIDE THE RAIN BARREL: camera at eye level beside a large rain barrel set at the near bank edge, the barrel closing the near right and the canal crossing the picture to the far bank beyond.
OVER THE NEAR COILED ROPE: camera low above a thick coiled rope lying on the near stones, the canal crossing the frame fully beyond it and the far buildings banked along the top edge.
FROM THE BARGE ROOF: camera standing height on the flat roof of a wide barge moored on the near side, the roof planks cropping the bottom edge and the market canal crossing the frame beyond.

ACROSS FROM THE INLET MOUTH: camera on a narrow inlet that opens onto the main canal, the inlet water in the near foreground and the main canal crossing the full picture left to right beyond the junction.
AT THE HALF-OPEN SHUTTER: camera behind a timber shutter folded back flat against the near wall, the shutter closing the far left and the canal and far bank filling the open picture to the right.

FROM THE STONE LANDING: camera at waist height on a broad stone landing on the near bank, the worn stone edge crossing the near bottom and the canal opening wide and flat across the rest of the picture.
PAST THE DRAPED NET: camera at eye level with a spread fishing net hanging slack from a near post, its mesh crossing the near left of the frame and the market canal open wide beyond it.

AT THE END OF THE LONG JETTY: camera at the far tip of a timber jetty projecting from the near bank, the jetty planks receding behind the frame and the canal surrounding it on both sides, the market crossing the picture ahead.
